description: Implementation of UE scheduler logic for 5G NR, including cell management, slot processing, and scheduling strategies.

classes.name: ue_scheduler_impl
classes.description: Main class implementing UE scheduling, cell management, and slot processing.

classes.name: ue_scheduler_impl::cell_context
classes.description: Represents context and resources for a specific cell within the scheduler.

methods.name: do_add_cell
methods.description: Adds a new cell to the scheduler and creates its event manager.

methods.name: do_start_cell
methods.description: Starts processing events for a specified cell.

methods.name: do_stop_cell
methods.description: Stops processing events and sub-schedulers for a specified cell.

methods.name: do_rem_cell
methods.description: Removes a cell from the scheduler.

methods.name: run_sched_strategy
methods.description: Executes scheduling policy for downlink and uplink slices for a cell.

methods.name: run_slot_impl
methods.description: Processes a slot, updating UEs, scheduling, and handling results.
